settings.question: How do I hear about the next event?
settings.answer: Join the club to receive first access to event announcements and ticket releases.

settings.question: Do clothing purchases include an event ticket?
settings.answer: Selected drops include a ticket to the next Elysian event. The offer is shown on the product and at checkout.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders are prepared in Lisbon and dispatched as soon as possible. You will receive tracking details by email.

settings.question: Can I return an item?
settings.answer: Contact us within 14 days of delivery and we will guide you through the return process.
